prompt.en: A group chat is deciding how to spend a free afternoon. Your first contribution is…
prompt.zh: 群聊在讨论一个空闲下午怎么过，你首先会……

label.en: Make a sideways joke before saying what I actually feel like doing.
label.zh: 先绕着开个玩笑，再说自己真正想做什么。

label.en: Suggest an unfamiliar place and imagine what we could discover there.
label.zh: 提议去没去过的地方，想象能发现什么。

label.en: Ask which option lets us spend more time together.
label.zh: 问哪种安排能让大家多待在一起。

label.en: State my preference plainly, including what I am not up for.
label.zh: 明确说出偏好，也说清自己不愿参与什么。

prompt.en: A small event needs a volunteer. Which role would you pick first?
prompt.zh: 一个小活动需要志愿者，你会优先选哪种工作？

label.en: Set the target, deadline and responsibility for the main task.
label.zh: 确定主要任务的目标、截止时间和分工。

label.en: Observe the moving parts and write a running order.
label.zh: 观察各个环节，写一份流程。

label.en: Handle the practical job that makes somebody’s evening easier.
label.zh: 接手能让别人当晚轻松一点的实际工作。

label.en: Give the invitation a voice and look that feel like mine.
label.zh: 让邀请函的语气和样子更像自己的风格。

prompt.en: A shared project has stalled. You are most likely to…
prompt.zh: 合作项目停住了，你更可能……

label.en: Read the notes and find the detail everyone passed over.
label.zh: 翻看记录，找出大家略过的细节。

label.en: Ask who needs a hand and complete one concrete piece.
label.zh: 问谁需要帮忙，先完成一个具体部分。

label.en: Make a short plan with one owner for each next step.
label.zh: 列一份短计划，让下一步各有负责人。

label.en: Name the awkward mood with humour before returning to the issue.
label.zh: 用幽默点出尴尬，再回到问题。

prompt.en: Someone invites you to something outside your usual routine. Your first thought is…
prompt.zh: 有人邀请你做一件日常范围之外的事，你首先想到……

label.en: There may be a new experience I want to try for myself.
label.zh: 也许有一种值得自己试试的新体验。

label.en: I will decide after checking whether it suits my boundaries.
label.zh: 先看是否符合自己的边界，再决定。

label.en: I could show a different side of myself in that setting.
label.zh: 可以在那个场合展现自己不同的一面。

label.en: I want to know whether they especially want me there.
label.zh: 想知道对方是否特别希望我去。

prompt.en: You can redesign one corner of a shared room. What interests you most?
prompt.zh: 可以重新布置公共房间的一个角落，你最感兴趣的是……

label.en: Making the space express a style I have been wanting to claim.
label.zh: 让空间呈现自己一直想尝试的风格。

label.en: An unexpected detail that makes people laugh when they notice it.
label.zh: 一个被人发现时会让人发笑的意外细节。

label.en: Trying a colour or material I have never used before.
label.zh: 尝试没用过的颜色或材料。

label.en: Arranging objects so they quietly tell a coherent story.
label.zh: 让物件的安排安静地讲出一个完整故事。

prompt.en: A friend’s plans fall through. You offer support by…
prompt.zh: 朋友的安排落空了，你会怎样支持对方？

label.en: Offering a ride, a meal or another specific practical favour.
label.zh: 提出接送、吃饭等一项具体帮助。

label.en: Checking whether they would like company for the evening.
label.zh: 问对方当晚是否想有人陪。

label.en: Helping them say clearly what treatment they will accept.
label.zh: 帮对方说清愿意接受怎样的对待。

label.en: Working out a replacement plan and its immediate steps.
label.zh: 一起拟定替代安排和眼下步骤。

prompt.en: You are introducing yourself to a new hobby group. You would rather…
prompt.zh: 向一个新的兴趣小组介绍自己时，你更愿意……

label.en: Find a friendly person and build a warm exchange with them.
label.zh: 先找到友善的人，聊出一点亲近感。

label.en: Choose a short introduction that presents the side I want to show.
label.zh: 用一段简短介绍呈现自己想展示的一面。

label.en: Start with a self-aware joke and keep the introduction informal.
label.zh: 用一个自知的玩笑开头，让介绍轻松些。

label.en: Help set things up and let the conversation happen alongside it.
label.zh: 一边帮忙准备，一边自然聊天。

prompt.en: A group discussion is going in circles. Your preferred contribution is…
prompt.zh: 集体讨论反复兜圈，你更想提供哪种帮助？

label.en: Say the uncomfortable point directly without apologising for having a view.
label.zh: 直接说出难以启齿的要点，不为有自己的看法而道歉。

label.en: Ask for a decision, a deadline and a clear next action.
label.zh: 推动确定决定、期限和下一步行动。

label.en: Summarise what each person actually said before adding a suggestion.
label.zh: 先概括每个人实际说过什么，再给建议。

label.en: Open an alternative that changes how we see the problem.
label.zh: 提出一个能改变看问题方式的新选项。

prompt.en: You have an unexpected hour alone. What sounds most appealing?
prompt.zh: 突然有一小时独处时间，哪件事最吸引你？

label.en: Follow a thought into music, humour or an unplanned detour.
label.zh: 跟着一个念头听音乐、找笑点或随意转转。

label.en: Finish a defined task and see a clear result.
label.zh: 完成一项明确任务，看到具体结果。

label.en: Do something I have chosen without explaining it to anyone.
label.zh: 做一件自己选的事，不必向别人解释。

label.en: Write or organise something I have been quietly noticing.
label.zh: 写下或整理最近默默留意的事。

prompt.en: A friend asks for ideas for a personal celebration. You focus first on…
prompt.zh: 朋友请你为一个私人庆祝活动出主意，你首先关注……

label.en: An imaginative experience neither of us has tried.
label.zh: 一种彼此都没试过的有想象力的体验。

label.en: What would make them feel especially wanted and included.
label.zh: 怎样让对方感到自己被重视、被欢迎。

label.en: What would make the day easier to organise and enjoy.
label.zh: 怎样让当天更好安排、更省心。

label.en: A theme or presentation that says something distinctive about them.
label.zh: 一种能表达对方独特之处的主题或呈现方式。

prompt.en: You disagree with feedback on something you made. Your first useful move would be…
prompt.zh: 你不同意别人对作品的反馈，首先会采取哪种做法？

label.en: Ask which concrete change would help the thing work better.
label.zh: 问哪一项具体调整能让作品更好用。

label.en: Try another version to see whether the idea opens up.
label.zh: 试做另一个版本，看看想法能否展开。

label.en: Read their exact comments and separate observation from inference.
label.zh: 细读原话，区分观察和推断。

label.en: Ask what they did appreciate so I understand where we still connect.
label.zh: 问对方欣赏了哪些部分，理解彼此仍能连接之处。

prompt.en: A minor mix-up has made a meeting awkward. You tend to…
prompt.zh: 一个小误会让聚会有点尴尬，你通常会……

label.en: Reset the arrangement so the same mix-up is less likely.
label.zh: 重新安排，减少同样误会再次发生。

label.en: Use a light aside to acknowledge that the moment feels strange.
label.zh: 用一句轻松的话承认当下有点别扭。

label.en: Choose a different tone and reintroduce myself on my own terms.
label.zh: 换一种语气，按自己的方式重新打开对话。

label.en: Say what happened and what I want to happen next.
label.zh: 说清发生了什么，以及自己接下来希望怎样。

prompt.en: An idea board has room for one more contribution. You add…
prompt.zh: 创意板还能再放一条内容，你会加上……

label.en: A striking example of a voice or style we could try.
label.zh: 一个可以尝试的鲜明语气或风格样例。

label.en: A clear statement of what I want this project to stand for.
label.zh: 一句清楚表达自己希望项目体现什么的话。

label.en: A surprising possibility that stretches the original idea.
label.zh: 一个能拓宽原构想的意外可能性。

label.en: A note about a practical need somebody may have overlooked.
label.zh: 一条关于可能被忽略的实际需要的备注。

prompt.en: A friend asks how your week has been. You are more likely to begin with…
prompt.zh: 朋友问这一周过得怎样，你更可能从什么说起？

label.en: How connected or distant I felt from the people I care about.
label.zh: 自己与在意的人之间感到多近或多远。

label.en: A pattern I noticed after watching several small moments.
label.zh: 从几个小片段中观察到的一种模式。

label.en: An odd little story that conveys my mood indirectly.
label.zh: 一个间接表达心情的奇怪小故事。

label.en: What I managed to complete and what remains on the list.
label.zh: 完成了什么，以及清单上还剩什么。

prompt.en: You are choosing how to contribute to a shared newsletter. You pick…
prompt.zh: 为一份共同制作的简报供稿，你会选……

label.en: An observed scene shaped into a careful short piece.
label.zh: 把观察到的一个场景整理成细致短文。

label.en: A personal column with a deliberately chosen voice.
label.zh: 一篇用自己选定语气写的个人专栏。

label.en: An organised update with outcomes and next commitments.
label.zh: 一份条理清晰、列出成果和后续约定的进展。

label.en: An experimental image or idea that changes the usual format.
label.zh: 一张实验性的图或一个改变惯常格式的点子。

prompt.en: Someone you know seems left out at a gathering. Your first response is…
prompt.zh: 聚会中一位认识的人像是被冷落了，你首先会……

label.en: Make an explicit space for them in the conversation.
label.zh: 在对话中明确给对方留出位置。

label.en: Bring something they need and stay nearby if they want.
label.zh: 送去对方需要的东西，并在对方愿意时待在附近。

label.en: Invite them to sit with me and check whether they want company.
label.zh: 邀请对方坐过来，问是否想有人陪。

label.en: Offer an easy joke that lets them join without a formal introduction.
label.zh: 用一个容易接上的玩笑，让对方自然加入。

prompt.en: A weekend plan has several equally workable options. You decide by…
prompt.zh: 周末有几个都可行的安排，你会怎样决定？

label.en: Comparing the details we have actually heard about each option.
label.zh: 比较自己实际听到的各项细节。

label.en: Picking the experience that fits the version of myself I want to try today.
label.zh: 选一种符合今天想尝试的自我表达的体验。

label.en: Checking which option gives us the connection we want.
label.zh: 看哪种安排能提供彼此想要的相处。

label.en: Naming my choice clearly and hearing other people’s limits.
label.zh: 明确说出自己的选择，也听其他人的限制。

prompt.en: You can make one small change to a routine. What draws you?
prompt.zh: 可以对日常习惯做一个小调整，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Set a specific result and a way to see whether it happened.
label.zh: 确定一个具体结果，以及确认它是否发生的方法。

label.en: Leave room for an unplanned moment instead of scripting everything.
label.zh: 留一点没写进安排的余地。

label.en: Replace one familiar part with something curious and new.
label.zh: 用一件好奇的新事物替换一个熟悉环节。

label.en: Remove a small practical burden for myself or someone close.
label.zh: 减轻自己或亲近的人一项实际负担。

prompt.en: A collaboration needs a restart after a break. You prefer to…
prompt.zh: 合作暂停后需要重新开始，你更愿意……

label.en: Show up with the materials or assistance that are needed.
label.zh: 带来所需材料或实际协助。

label.en: Reconnect personally before returning to the work.
label.zh: 先在人与人之间重新联系，再回到任务。

label.en: Confirm the goal and the next commitment with everyone.
label.zh: 与大家确认目标和下一项约定。

label.en: Refresh the way we present the work so it feels alive again.
label.zh: 更新作品的呈现方式，让它重新有生气。

prompt.en: At the end of a shared experience, what would you most like to keep?
prompt.zh: 共同经历结束时，你最想留下什么？

label.en: A funny, honest account of how it felt from the inside.
label.zh: 一段有趣又坦诚、写出内心感受的叙述。

label.en: A small record that helps me understand what happened.
label.zh: 一份帮助自己理解发生了什么的小记录。

label.en: A clear sense that my voice and boundaries had room.
label.zh: 自己的声音和边界得到容纳的明确感受。

label.en: A new possibility I would like to explore further.
label.zh: 一种还想继续探索的新可能。

sourceScope: Seasons one and two only. Brief story anchors are separated from the original question-to-route mapping.
